extDescription.message: Multi-connection download manager with resume. Save web videos (MP4, M3U8), merge audio and video, save pages, batch download.

menuDownloadMedia.message: Download this video or audio with Shuttle DM

menuGrabSelection.message: Download all links in the selection…

menuGrabAll.message: Download all links and resources on this page…

notifyNoMediaBody.message: Play the video first, then click the Shuttle DM icon in the toolbar to see what was detected.

blockedSiteMessage.message: Shuttle DM doesn’t download videos from YouTube.

dashNote.message: DASH manifests can’t be downloaded directly yet. Audio and video tracks detected during playback are listed separately.

drmMediaNote.message: This media is protected by DRM and can’t be downloaded

errNoMediaData.message: No usable audio or video data

errNoMoovFile.message: No moov box found; not a valid MP4 file

panelHint.message: Not listed? Play the video for a moment and try again.

toolSaveHtmlTitle.message: Save the page’s current HTML (images still load from the web)

toolGrabTitle.message: List every link, image, audio and video on this page, then download the ones you pick

toolNewTaskTitle.message: Paste links to start new downloads

pasteLinksPlaceholder.message: Paste download links, one per line

takeoverSwitchTitle.message: When on, matching browser downloads are handed to Shuttle DM and downloaded with multiple connections

takeoverOn.message: On: browser downloads will be handled by Shuttle DM

takeoverOff.message: Off: the browser will handle its own downloads

mediaEmptyTitle.message: No video or audio detected yet

mediaEmptyBody.message: Play a video on the page and downloadable items will appear here. You can also hover over the video and click “Download video”.

otherFeaturesStillWork.message: Other features, such as saving pages, still work.

pageNotAllowed.message: The browser doesn’t allow extensions on this page

enterHttpLinks.message: Enter links that start with http:// or https://

linksAlreadyListed.message: These links are already in the download list

clearDoneTitle.message: Removes them from the list only; downloaded files are kept

clearedCompleted.message: Removed from the list (the files are still on your computer)

emptyListBody.message: Right-click a link and choose “Download link with Shuttle DM”, or play a video and click “Download video” on it. You can also paste links:

fileRecordMissing.message: Can’t find where this file was saved

fileMissing.message: The file is missing. It may have been moved or deleted.

threadsLabel_one.message: $1 connection downloading (each line is the whole file; orange marks what that connection has finished)

threadsLabel_other.message: $1 connections downloading (each line is the whole file; orange marks what that connection has finished)

newUrlsPlaceholder.message: Paste links, one per line. Regular files and .m3u8 video streams are supported.

filenamePlaceholder.message: Leave empty to use the name from the server

subfolderPlaceholder.message: e.g. Courses/Week 1, inside your browser’s downloads folder

refererLabel.message: Referer (address of the page the link came from)

noHttpLinks.message: No links starting with http:// or https:// were found

deleteFilesToo.message: Also delete the downloaded files from this computer

deleteOneText.message: “$1” will be removed from the list.

deleteTempToo.message: Its temporary data will be deleted too.

deleteManyText.message: These downloads will be removed from the list.

deleteManyTemp_one.message: Temporary data for $1 unfinished download will be deleted too.

deleteManyTemp_other.message: Temporary data for $1 unfinished downloads will be deleted too.

tempDataTitle.message: Temporary data for downloads in progress. It’s cleaned up automatically when they finish.

welcome1.message: When you play a video, the toolbar icon shows how many streams were found. Hover over a video and click “Download video”.

welcome2.message: Right-click any link and choose “Download link with Shuttle DM”, or paste links here, to download with multiple connections.

welcome3.message: The browser’s own downloads (archives, installers, videos and more) are handed to Shuttle DM automatically. You can turn this off in Settings.

optThreadsHelp.message: Files are split into parts that download at the same time. Browsers open at most 6 connections to one HTTP/1.1 server; HTTP/2 servers don’t have this limit.

optMaxConcurrentHelp.message: Extra downloads wait in a queue and start when earlier ones finish.

optSpeedLimitHelp.message: Maximum combined speed of all downloads. 0 means no limit.

optRetriesHelp.message: A dropped connection reconnects automatically and continues from where it stopped.

optSubfolderHelp.message: Inside your browser’s downloads folder. Leave empty to save directly in the downloads folder.

optCategorize.message: Sort into folders by file type

optCategorizeHelp.message: Videos, music, documents, archives, programs, images, web pages and other files each get their own folder.

optNotify.message: Notify me when a download finishes or fails

optOverlay.message: Show a “Download video” button on web videos

optOverlayHelp.message: The button appears in the top-right corner when you hover over a video. Click it to pick a quality and download.

optSniffMin.message: Ignore audio and video smaller than

optSniffMinHelp.message: Filters out small files such as notification sounds and preview clips.

optHlsFormatHelp.message: MP4 is rebuilt from the segments without quality loss and plays on phones and computers. Codecs that can’t be converted, such as HEVC, are saved as TS automatically.

optTakeover.message: Hand browser downloads to Shuttle DM

optTakeoverHelp.message: Downloads that match the rules below are downloaded by Shuttle DM with multiple connections. If Shuttle DM can’t request the link again (for example, when a form has to be submitted), the browser finishes the download as usual.

optTakeoverMin.message: Only take over files larger than

optTakeoverMinHelp.message: Small files are quicker for the browser to download by itself.

optTakeoverExclude.message: Never take over on these sites

optTakeoverExcludeHelp.message: Domains separated by spaces or new lines, e.g. files.example.com.

optTakeoverExcludePlaceholder.message: Leave empty to apply to all sites

optTempDataHelp.message: Downloads in progress are kept in storage space the browser gives the extension. When they finish, they move to your downloads folder and the space is freed.

aboutLocal.message: Downloading and video merging happen entirely in your browser. Nothing goes through third-party servers.

aboutOss.message: Open-source components: mux.js (Apache-2.0, TS remuxing) and the Barlow Semi Condensed font (SIL OFL 1.1).

aboutLegal.message: Only download content you have the right to save. Videos protected by DRM (such as Widevine or FairPlay) can’t and won’t be downloaded.

grabSearchPlaceholder.message: Filter by URL or text (* = wildcard)

grabNoLinks.message: No links were found on this page.

grabExpired.message: This link list has expired. Go back to the page and open “Batch download” again.
